title: Losing your mother tongue
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Can you lose part of your mother tongue after living abroad for many years?
Which is more emotionally important: speaking a language perfectly or feeling connected to it?
How can parents help children keep a family language while living in another country?
Would you feel differently if you could understand your mother tongue but no longer speak it easily?
What parts of identity can become harder to express when a language becomes weaker?
